_doc: Engine-consumable activity data (loader: activities.rs). looks = the only massing vocabulary; family_looks = V0.2 geometry family -> look (traceability; installation families are the ground kinds); ground = installation kinds; archetypes = V0.2 ids resolved to a look/ground, with the services.json role they specialise (role), the catalogue.json farmstead.buildings key they equal (farmstead) and `only` = culture ids or family names allowed (absent = all); `form` = the singular building an isolated yard building becomes (activities.rs `formed`): role = services.json role whose town form is built, site = [width along the front, depth] in metres, has = part label the culture's form must hold (else the single ring stays), absorbs = archetypes of the same yard that join the form instead of standing beside it; sites = V0.2 templates (context = AND of potentials, `a|b` = either; promote = never|households|worker_households|institutional|resident; target = access target; only = culture gate); cultures = per family transport/allow_categories (empty = all)/deny (archetype ids)/prefer (weight, default 1); overrides per culture replace transport and allow_categories when present, add to deny and prefer.

open_surface.semantic: Bare or lightly worked ground: threshing floor, haystack, apiary

enclosure.semantic: Fenced or walled yard: corral, fence, caravan yard

water_structure.semantic: Water-bound work: weir, leat, ditch, pond, trap, breakwater, salt pans

industrial_ground.semantic: Open firing/working ground: clamp, kiln, sawpit, drying racks, pits

landing.semantic: Shore edge: ramp, pier, rafting or canoe landing

excavation.semantic: Hole in the ground: quarry face, clay pit, shaft, adit

mound.semantic: Heaped material: spoil, slag, cairn cache

engineered_path.semantic: Built linear way: ramp, causeway, bund, stairs

underground_work.semantic: Dug gallery or pit below the surface: qanat, passage, storage pit

crossing.semantic: Span over a gap: rope or trail bridge
